reviewer.identity: gpt-6-astra high independent image-pair evidence; /root/vision_exemplars delegated acceptance review

role_and_message.evidence: The image-to-3D-model architecture remains intact, including corresponding/random viewpoints, rendered views, view discrimination, reconstruction loss and internal pressure loss.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All three inputs, encoder, shape and texture decoders, two renderers, two gradient reversal modules, discriminator, view comparison, internal pressure module, three losses and four legend entries are retained.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Labels and notation remain legible and unchanged: x_ij, v_ij, v_kl, Enc, Dec_s, Dec_t, P, Dis, L_r, L_d and L_p, together with both View labels and 3D model.

connections_and_direction.evidence: The encoder branches to both decoders; their combined model feeds both renderers and internal pressure. Corresponding and random viewpoints feed their respective renderers. The upper view and original image feed view comparison; both rendered views pass through gradient reversal to the shared discriminator. All three loss connections retain their directions.

visual_encodings.evidence: Green dashed input grouping, peach dashed loss grouping, yellow trainable modules and white other-function modules retain their original meanings and match the legend. The added explanatory banner does not reclassify any module.

examples_and_data.evidence: Neither figure contains measured data or concrete example images. The derivative introduces no measurements, outcomes or class identities.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The added banner states that the discriminator minimizes L_d while the encoder and decoders maximize it through gradient reversal. Both statements are explicitly supported by the supplied original caption.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The derivative full image contains the complete architecture, loss region, legend and added banner with readable text. Cropping at the detail-image boundaries does not affect completeness of the full image.

remaining_limitations: Assessment uses the supplied images and caption. The reported pixel proof was not independently verified; it covers only its listed rectangle. Retained source resolution and visual blemishes are independently scored; no quality-informed reroll.
caption:
Figure 2. Architecture of the proposed method. The main point of our method is the use of discrimination loss to learn priors of views.
While the discriminator aims to minimize discrimination loss, the encoder and decoders try to maximize it using a gradient reversal layer.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed complete final and caption. Entire original encoder/two decoders, corresponding/random render views, gradient-reversal paths, discriminator and three lossbranches remain. New min/max banner directly matches caption: discriminator minimizesLd, encoder/decoders maximizeLd viaGRL. All notation,legend and directions preserved; no added adversarial edge.
